modules.name: configuration
modules.purpose: Load, validate, resolve and hash the scientific configuration; preserve fixed settings and stop on invalid input.

modules.name: records
modules.purpose: Validate typed handoff records, identifiers, dependency hashes, explicit statuses and required provenance.

modules.name: identity
modules.purpose: Create stable cryptographic identifiers and seeds; record code, model, tokenizer, dataset and content identities.

modules.name: storage
modules.purpose: Publish verified artifacts atomically where supported, enforce exclusive ownership and durable storage, and invalidate stale dependencies.

modules.name: checkpointing
modules.purpose: Save, verify and restore full training state at original step identities; retain specified recovery and scientific snapshots.

modules.name: judge_client
modules.purpose: Separate provider transports and per-pass caches; validate schemas and returned identities; preserve outcomes without fabricated rewards or grades.

modules.name: response_parsing
modules.purpose: Freeze phase-specific reasoning and final-answer parsing; apply exact numeric/choice/code rules and never repair model answers.

modules.name: cost_accounting
modules.purpose: Track GPU, API, storage and in-flight costs; enforce current authorization and block new spending when unavailable.

modules.name: preflight
modules.purpose: Check model/runtime identity, actual loss masks and gradients, persistence/recovery, APIs, sandbox, baseline measurement and statistical readiness before affected launches.

modules.name: execution_state
modules.purpose: Track jobs, original steps, attempts, persistent retry counts and explicit pending/running/paused/failed/complete states; prevent duplicate writers.

modules.name: candidate_manifest
modules.purpose: Construct authorized English LMSYS first-turn candidates at most 200 tokens, deduplicate, remove detectable overlap and freeze deterministic order.

modules.name: mbpp_sandbox
modules.purpose: Isolate untrusted generated code; withhold hidden tests from prompts and secrets from execution; enforce one CPU, one GiB, five CPU seconds and ten wall seconds.

modules.name: baseline_repeatability
modules.purpose: Run untouched baselines at seeds 42,43,44 on the same 1233 items; check retention and common overlap without extra legibility calls.

modules.name: statistical_validation
modules.purpose: Freeze and execute the design-aware simultaneous-bound simulation plan and quantitative coverage acceptance rule before trained outcome inspection.

modules.name: assets
modules.origin: User implementation assignment and permitted H.9 operational conventions; not an original scientific workflow.
modules.purpose: Bounded immutable upstream provisioning, verified standard Hub blobs/snapshots, local-only SDK model loading and license authorization.
modules.sections: User master request: automated environment setup and reusable model/dataset assets; E.1.4,E.2.2,E.2.5; H.9

modules.name: artifacts
modules.origin: User implementation assignment and permitted H.9 operational conventions; not an original scientific workflow.
modules.purpose: Indexed immutable artifact provenance, incremental permanent replication, remote reconciliation and exact-compatible retrieval.
modules.sections: User master request: complete Google Drive artifact persistence; E.1.3,E.2.3,E.2.5; H.9

modules.name: drive
modules.origin: User implementation assignment and permitted H.9 operational conventions; not an original scientific workflow.
modules.purpose: Restricted drive.file OAuth consent and refresh, actual token-scope/account/project checks and integrity-checked bounded media transport.
modules.sections: User master request: existing Google OAuth client, designated account and project-confined persistence; E.2.5; H.9

modules.name: hardware
modules.origin: User implementation assignment and permitted H.9 operational conventions; not an original scientific workflow.
modules.purpose: Inspect observed CPU/RAM/disk/CUDA/BF16 prerequisites separately from recommendations and unexecuted peak-memory measurements.
modules.sections: User master request: explicit hardware/resource specifications; E.1.1,E.1.2; H.9

modules.name: reporting
modules.origin: User implementation assignment and permitted H.9 operational conventions; not an original scientific workflow.
modules.purpose: Export exact analysis records, honest missing/indeterminate values, fixture labels and actual capability/opacity curve coordinates.
modules.sections: User master request: complete scientific results and report artifacts; D.2.5,G,H.6; H.9

modules.name: runpod
modules.origin: User implementation assignment and permitted H.9 operational conventions; not an original scientific workflow.
modules.purpose: Concrete authorization guards and external existing-Pod cost/runtime monitoring with bounded observed stop confirmation; no implicit new-Pod authorization.
modules.sections: User master request: authorized RunPod deployment; subsequent existing-H100 authorization 90 USD / 30 hours; E.1.5,E.2.5; H.9

modules.name: validation
modules.origin: User implementation assignment and permitted H.9 operational conventions; not an original scientific workflow.
modules.purpose: Repeatable static source/path/card/diagram/requirement/link/PDF integrity audit, explicitly independent of live scientific readiness.
modules.sections: User master request: cross-artifact consistency, complete inventory and nine acceptance gates; E.2.8; H.9

modules.name: workflow
modules.origin: User implementation assignment and permitted H.9 operational conventions; not an original scientific workflow.
modules.purpose: Composable dependency graph with immutable configuration/code/output identities, per-device serialization and verified completed-stage reuse.
modules.sections: User master request: modular independently accessible execution and automatic compatible resumption; E.1.4,E.2.5; H.9

modules.name: collection_inputs
modules.origin: User request for Google Drive as the sole permanent store; original CPU inputs must retain provenance under consumer revalidation.
modules.purpose: Complete offline source/tokenizer/panel revalidation and immutable consumer certificate checks for truthful restored CPU input reuse.
modules.sections: User request: Drive-only permanent storage and reusable original collection inputs; E.1.4,E.2.3-E.2.5; H.9
